subject: Supply Chain & Logistics
title: Failure Mode Analysis
description: A 60-second lesson on Failure Mode Analysis.

hook.text: What if the port closes? What if the supplier's factory floods? FMEA asks every 'what if' systematically.

buildup.text: Failure Mode and Effects Analysis (FMEA) identifies potential failures, their causes, and their impact.

discovery.text: Each failure is scored on likelihood, severity, and detectability. High scores get mitigation plans.

twist.text: FMEA only works if teams are honest about failures. Optimism bias causes teams to underrate risks.

climax.text: Companies using FMEA reduce unplanned disruptions by 30–50% through proactive mitigation plans.

punchline.text: List every way things can fail. Then prevent the worst.

quiz.question: What three dimensions does FMEA score?
